# Favourite toggle (`favourite-toggle`)

Star toggle for favourites.

Group: Actions. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/actions';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createFavouriteToggle` (types in `dist/web/actions/favouriteToggle.d.ts`): `.mh-favourite-toggle` (`--sm | --lg`, `--labelled`): a star toggle button with `aria-pressed`. Pressing it toggles the star, plays a short pop (`.is-popping`, not with reduced motion) and calls `onChange`.

```ts
export function createFavouriteToggle(options: FavouriteToggleOptions = {}): FavouriteToggleHandle;

export interface FavouriteToggleOptions {
  pressed?: boolean;
  /** The accessible name; it stays the same whether on or off (`aria-pressed` carries the state). Default "Favourite". */
  label?: string;
  /** Show the label next to the star. */
  showLabel?: boolean;
  size?: FavouriteToggleSize;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Runs after a press, with the new state. */
  onChange?: (pressed: boolean) => void;
}

export interface FavouriteToggleHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  readonly pressed: boolean;
  setPressed(pressed: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createFavouriteToggle, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('Not on the home screen', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const favourite = createFavouriteToggle({
  label: 'Favourite: Kitchen light',
  onChange: (pressed) => {
    status.textContent = pressed ? 'Pinned to the home screen' : 'Not on the home screen';
  },
});

document.body.append(favourite.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { FavouriteToggle, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function FavouriteToggleExample() {
  const [pinned, setPinned] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <FavouriteToggle label="Favourite: Kitchen light" pressed={pinned} onPressedChange={setPinned} />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {pinned ? 'Pinned to the home screen' : 'Not on the home screen'}
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
